scripts.dev: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run dev --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run dev -w @seoro/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run start:dev -w @seoro/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run build -w @seoro/api && npm run build -w @seoro/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run build -w @seoro/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @seoro/shared && npm run build -w @seoro/api
